notes: Article on הָאָבוֹת takes the possessive 'their' standing before its own word (r41 'the days of their feasting'); supplied 'houses' joins elliptical אָבוֹת (r31).

'in the host' on צָבָא is equally the rectum's recast relation under r19; placement unaffected.
